correctness.rationale: The ternary bracket is reconstructed from the affine Lie bracket, and the full eight-triple Rota-Baxter defect reduces to four polynomial equations. The split b=0 versus b!=0 is exhaustive over a field of characteristic not two and gives exactly the three stated pieces. The automorphism equations u=0 and s(p^2-1)=0 are derived from all triple products, and the conjugation action yields the orbit census. The binary Lie-algebra equations are separately reconstructed, proving the strict inclusion of the Lie-induced operators. Exhaustive checks over F3, F5, and F7 reproduce totals, ranks, and orbit sizes.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical nonzero Lie triple system obtained from the unique nonabelian two-dimensional Lie algebra, so it is a natural minimal test case for the ternary Rota-Baxter theory rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem gives the complete operator variety, rank distribution, automorphism quotient, and extension-field zeta function. It also shows structurally that the standard Lie-to-triple construction misses an entire affine-plane branch of ternary Rota-Baxter operators, providing a concrete and quantified converse failure.
